source.description:
Taiwanese Twin Actors Reunion

Four Taiwanese twin actors—Li Zhixi, Li Zhiqi, Song Yimin, and Song Damin—stand together in a studio portrait. Dressed in pastel shirts and neutral jackets, the two pairs of twins display nearly identical features and warm smiles, underscoring the frequent confusion among fans who watched their 1990s costume dramas and Qiong Yao adaptations.

Both Li brothers and Song brothers gained fame through roles in series like "The Beggar Emperor Legend" and "Plum Blossom Trilogy." Their parallel careers, similar names, and matching appearances have long puzzled viewers. This portrait captures their shared legacy in Taiwa
